verdict.rationale: An AI-training opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS customer-data platform that advertises AI-powered audiences, so the axis applies. However, the pack contains no documented control that keeps customer data out of model training. The Privacy Portal and Consent Management cover regulatory compliance and end-user collection consent, which are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
